full_prompt_en: An intricately stippled, engraving-like illustration presents an extreme close-up portrait, with one man’s eye and mustached face filling the left side beside an ornate purple-brown helmet and collar. The crop cuts across the forehead and lower jaw, showing one eye, part of the nose, closed lips, a curled mustache, and a short beard. His gaze is directed forward and slightly downward, and the skin is rendered in pale gray with fine pores and short beard hairs. A thick mustache curves over the upper lip, blending into a close beard along the cheek and chin. On the right, a sculpted helmet or face armor rises close to his temple. Its surface is densely covered with raised scrollwork, curled ridges and small leaf-like motifs, all picked out in dark violet-brown and charcoal. A curved inner border follows the cheek, with dark fine shading separating the face from the relief-covered armor. Along the lower edge, a high decorated collar or neck guard carries repeated patterns and overlapping bands. The metal-like ornament is matte rather than mirror-bright, with subtle highlights tracing the raised relief. The far-right background is a pale, nearly blank area that separates the dark sculpted surface from the edge of the frame. Light falls softly from the front-left, revealing the eye, nose bridge and mustache while leaving the recesses of the helmet much darker. The limited palette of gray skin, plum-brown ornament, charcoal and pale cream keeps the close detail cohesive. Fine etched lines and tiny irregular marks make the surface feel carefully worked, while the shallow crop intensifies the scale of every feature. The composition divides attention between the living face and adjacent carved armor, with the eye acting as the clearest point of focus. Its mood is solemn and tactile, built from intimate proximity, subdued color and intricate relief.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅以精密点描和版画式刻绘呈现的极近景肖像，男子的一只眼睛与蓄须面孔占满左侧，旁边紧邻繁饰的紫褐色头盔和领甲。画框裁切过额头和下颌，显出一只眼睛、部分鼻子、闭合双唇、卷曲八字胡和短须。他的目光朝前并略向下，皮肤以浅灰色呈现，可见细小毛孔和短短胡茬。浓密八字胡弯覆上唇，并与贴面短须连成一体。右侧，一顶雕刻头盔或面甲紧贴太阳穴处升起。表面布满凸起卷纹、弯曲脊线和细小叶状纹饰，以深紫棕与炭灰刻画。弯曲内缘顺着脸颊延伸，细密深色阴影将面孔与浮雕甲面分开。画面下缘，高领或颈甲带有重复纹饰和层叠带状结构。仿金属装饰呈哑光而非镜面亮泽，细微高光沿凸起浮雕勾勒。最右侧背景近乎空白，呈浅色，使深色雕刻表面与画框边缘分开。柔和光线从左前方落下，照出眼睛、鼻梁和胡须，同时让头盔凹槽保持更暗。灰色肤色、梅紫棕饰面、炭灰和浅奶油色构成有限色谱，使极近细节保持统一。细密刻线与微小不规则痕迹使表面显得经过精心雕琢，紧密裁切则强化每处特征的视觉分量。构图在真实面孔与相邻雕刻甲具之间分配注意力，眼睛成为最清晰的焦点。整体气氛庄严而富触感，来自亲密距离、克制色彩和繁复浮雕。
style_prompt_en: Engraving-like linework and dense stippling articulate minute surface variations. This style is marked by high-resolution surface detail, sculpted relief and tightly controlled tonal contrast. Raised patterns catch narrow highlights while recessed areas hold deep shadow, making texture readable through light rather than bright color. A restrained palette of gray, muted plum, brown and charcoal keeps elaborate surfaces unified. Fine lines and repeated motifs create density, balanced by occasional plain areas that let the detail breathe. Close cropping magnifies small variations in material and edge. The overall effect is tactile, intricate and solemn, shaped by relief, tonal depth and selective clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 版画式线刻与密集点描刻画微小表面变化。这种风格以高密度表面细节、雕刻浮凸和克制明暗反差为特点。凸起纹样接住细窄高光，凹陷处保留深影，使质感主要通过受光关系而非鲜艳颜色显现。灰色、低调梅紫、棕色与炭灰构成收敛色谱，让繁复表面保持统一。细线和重复纹样增加密度，少量素净区域则留出呼吸空间。紧密裁切放大材质和边缘的细微变化。整体效果富触感、精巧而庄严，来自浮雕、明暗纵深和选择性清晰度。
theme_en: An extreme close-up portrait shows one man’s eye and mustached face beside an ornate purple-brown sculpted helmet and collar
theme_zh: 极近景肖像中，男子一只眼睛与蓄须面孔紧邻紫褐色繁饰雕刻头盔和领甲
name: Detailed
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
